behavior: Full rotatable V42 native assembly with visible, draggable Illustration spacing range (0–35 mm, default 16 mm), nominal seated and separated states, show/hide XEM/carrier/LDO, isometric/top/underside/side presets, plus exact native KiCanvas layout, parts/layers/nets and copper highlighting. Slider input changes actual attachment group translations, not just the displayed number.

routing_source.title: V42 carrier
routing_source.source_note: Model-only omissions in public PCB; native electrical geometry and saved filled polygons retained. Routing is rendered directly from this hash-checked KiCad file, not an approximate JSON conversion.

attachments_note: XEM and LDO simplified geometry reused with historical source hashes retained. Nominal mating gaps and component envelopes unqualified.
limits: Static native geometry and the assembly illustration do not establish electrical operation, signal integrity, thermal performance, populated mechanical fit, manufacturing acceptance or a fabrication release.
V42 relocates D601 and its local branch/ground connection only. V41 remains preserved; unrelated routing is retained.
Added separation is for illustration; 0 mm returns attachments to inherited nominal seating positions.
